outcome: Readiness first: the page exposes RRI interpretation only from a validated persisted rollout store. It reports schema/validation and matched-comparison eligibility before scientific comparisons; temporal plots require finite persisted step fields and show finite/total counts, missing counts, observed depth, and factual endpoint median. State-relative target RRI is the one-step diagnostic RRI_{t,i}^e = (Delta_t^e - Delta_{t|i}^e)/max(Delta_t^e, epsilon): candidate i is judged against the current state t, so its denominator changes with the accumulated reconstruction state. The selected-chain field cumulative_target_rri is the running sum of selected one-step values, not endpoint gain. Canonical persisted names are cumulative_target_rri, marginal_target_rri/selected_target_rri, target_rri, and cumulative_target_root_gain; no invented scientific fields are needed. The page keeps root-normalized target gain separate because it telescopes to endpoint gain, while state-relative RRI does not. Invalid candidates remain hard constraints and are not treated as low-RRI labels.
